Know that you will not be our guardian, even if the people of your Egypt gathered against you and said that you are a bad man, that would not make you sad, and if they said that you are a good man, that would not make you happy.
But expose yourself to what is in the Book of God. If you are following His path, ascetic in His asceticism, willing to encourage Him, and afraid of intimidating Him, then be steadfast and give good news, for what is said about you will not harm you.

Text_en:
Fatima’s relationship with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was not like the relationship of any daughter with her father, that is, just a body-to-body relationship. Rather, it was the soul's relationship with itself.

According to Al-Zahra, the Prophet is a divine attribute in existence, not an earthy essence in creation. It is from its father like a lamp is from a niche, a flame is from a stove, and a ray is from the sun.

Muslim was at the peak of courage, heroism, and daring.

text: فصعدوا ب #مسلم_بن_عقيل إلى سطح قصر الإمارة وهو يكبر ويستغفر ويصلّي على النبي محمّد صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم وملائكة الله ورسله، وهو يقول: "اللهم احكم بيننا وبين قومٍ غرّونا وكذّبونا وأذلونا"
Text_original: فصعدوا ب #مسلم_بن_عقيل إلى سطح قصر الإمارة وهو يكبر ويستغفر ويصلّي على النبي محمّد صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم وملائكة الله ورسله، وهو يقول: "اللهم احكم بيننا وبين قومٍ غرّونا وكذّبونا وأذلونا"
Text_en: So they took #Muslim_bin_Aqeel to the roof of the Emirate Palace, and he said “Allahu Akbar” and asked for forgiveness and prayed for the Prophet Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him and his family, and the angels of God and His messengers, and he said: “Oh God, judge between us and a people who deceived us, lied to us, and humiliated us.”

Muslim bin Aqeel said after they betrayed him
It is nothing but hope. Where is your security? We belong to God and to Him we shall return, and he cried.
Then he said: By God, I do not cry for myself, nor do I feel sorry for her from being killed, even if I did not want her to be destroyed even in the blink of an eye, but I cry for my family who are coming to me. I cry for Hussein and the family of #Hussein.

Imam Al-Rida, peace be upon him, said:
O Bin Shabib, #Muharram is the month in which the people of pre-Islamic times forbade oppression and fighting due to its sanctity. This nation did not know the sanctity of its month nor the sanctity of its Prophet (may God bless him and grant him peace).
